title: Engine lighting + shadow primitive — `engine/render/lighting/` module with dynamic lights + shadow maps
intent: Visual style refresh per `project-visual-fidelity-evolution` memory. The current renderer has 1 directional light + ambient hemispheric, NO shadow maps, NO point lights — per the original visual-style.md §4.1 ban (now softened). This story builds the engine-side primitive that enables: (1) multiple dynamic light sources per scene (1 directional key + up to 4 point/spot), (2) shadow maps per shadow-casting light (1024×1024 default, configurable), (3) per-mesh shadow-cast/receive flags via existing component patterns. Projects register lights at bootstrap; the renderer manages shadow textures + frustum culling. Engine-first per CLAUDE.md generic-primitives rule.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/visual-style.md §4.1` (revised 2026-05-28) + user request 'хочется видеть тени, источники света и прочие эффекты'. Mirrors the engine-first pattern from ragdoll module (GDP-024-001) + billboard primitive (GDP-027-008). Per CLAUDE.md, fundamental graphics primitives belong in `engine/`, not duplicated per project. Three.js already supports `PCFSoftShadowMap` + multi-light setup; this story exposes that surface via AGF's ECS + schema patterns rather than ad-hoc per-project wiring.
acceptanceHints: DIRECTORY: NEW `engine/render/lighting/`. Sits alongside existing render modules (mesh-handle-registry, billboard, etc.).
SCHEMA FILES (under `schemas/components/`):

light.schema.json — Light component { kind: 'directional'|'point'|'spot', color: '#hex', intensity: number, castShadow: boolean, shadowMapSize?: 512|1024|2048, ... per-kind fields (position offset for point, target for spot, etc.) }
shadow-caster.schema.json — ShadowCaster tag (entity casts shadows; renderer registers it in the shadow-map render pass)
shadow-receiver.schema.json — ShadowReceiver tag (entity receives shadows; renderer enables shadow-map sampling in its material)
All schemas validate via project-check.
RENDERER INTEGRATION (engine/render/three-renderer.ts or sibling):
Enable shadowMap on the WebGLRenderer (PCFSoftShadowMap, autoUpdate=true).
For each Light entity: instantiate the matching Three.js light class; if castShadow=true, configure shadow.camera (orthographic for directional, perspective for point/spot) + shadow.map size.
For each entity with Transform + MeshRenderer: read ShadowCaster + ShadowReceiver tags; set `mesh.castShadow` + `mesh.receiveShadow` accordingly.
LIGHTING SYSTEM (engine/render/lighting/lighting-system.ts):
Updates light Transform → matches Three.js light position/target per fixedUpdate (for moving lights — e.g. a bomb attaches a point light that follows it).
Disposes lights + shadow maps on entity removal.
Doctor section: 'Lights: N (M cast shadows, K total shadow-map texels)'. Warning if total shadow-map texels > 2M (perf risk).
PER-LIGHT BUDGET (defaults — projects override):
Directional: 1, shadow=true, shadowMapSize=2048 (covers whole arena).
Point: up to 4 simultaneously; shadow=true on up to 2 of them, shadowMapSize=512 each.
Spot: up to 2; shadow=true on up to 1, shadowMapSize=1024.
Exceeding the budget: doctor warns but render proceeds (Three.js handles gracefully).
AMBIENT + HEMISPHERIC: keep the existing setup as the base ambient layer. Lighting module adds dynamic lights on top.
PROJECT INTEGRATION SHAPE (first consumer GDP-2026-05-28-004 separately):

Kaboom Crew: register a directional key light from upper-left at boot. Register optional point lights when bombs enter the final 0.6s fuse window (per GDP-2026-05-28-004). Pickup-glow effects can register a soft attached point light for ambient brightening.
Beacon World drones (future): each drone could have its own attached spotlight.
POST-PROCESSING (NOT in this story — adjacent):
SSAO + better tonemapping + soft bloom = follow-up story `GDP-2026-05-28-006` (post-fx pipeline). This story is just lights + shadows. Bloom remains the existing simple emissive-only path.
PERFORMANCE BUDGET:

Web-friendly defaults: PCFSoftShadowMap is moderate cost; 1 directional + 2 point shadows ~ 5ms / frame on a modern laptop browser per Three.js examples. Within visual-style.md §11 budget (60fps target).
Mobile / low-end: shadowMap can be disabled at runtime via project config; geometry-only render path stays the fallback.
DETERMINISM: lighting is pure presentation — no gameplay state touched. Server-authoritative multiplayer unaffected; clients render their own shadows.
UNIT TESTS:
Light entity spawn → Three.js light created with matching params.
ShadowCaster tag → mesh.castShadow=true.
Light disposal → Three.js light + shadow map cleaned.
Doctor section: light counts + texel total accurate.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Reflection probes / IBL.
Light cookies / projected textures.
Stencil shadows (PCF-only).
Real-time GI / radiosity.
Per-frame light pruning beyond Three.js's existing limit.
